guide: Protected switch wiring and troubleshootingUse a short internal harness: J4 pin1 GND, pin2 3V3, pin3 SDA/GPIO41, pin4 SCL/GPIO42. Leave pin5 SAFE_N completely unconnected. Connect only the specified SW2 accessory. The marker and loopback check register/pin behavior; they do not identify an arbitrary device at0x20.Each external dry contact connects SW0 or SW1 to its dedicated ground return. Closed contact reads high, open contact reads low. Choose selection polarity per rule. Use contacts rated for dry circuits. An open wire looks like an open contact; a short to return looks like a closed contact. This circuit cannot diagnose wire continuity.Start with both rules Off: no I²C register traffic is requested. After connecting the unpowered assembly and confirming rails, select Input, channel, polarity and stable observation period. Watch acquisition status, then each rule’s raw/qualified level and age. Readback failure remains invalid until a completed control observation consumes the fault; recovery needs a new sample and qualification period. A clock/state fault requires an ECU restart. Fix the cause first.This draft is for inhibited bench development. Do not combine module USB power with carrier3V3. Supply loading, reset behavior, electrical faults, bus timing and enclosure fit still need physical tests.
